payload.posture: Read 1 Corinthians 14:34–40 as one movement in Paul's story, keeping the passage's actions, setting, sequence, and limits visible.
payload.tension: The passage states silence instructions and an appeal to orderly practice. Let the wives be quiet in the assemblies, for it has not been permitted for them to be talking except in submission, as the law also says, Let all things be done decently and in order. It does not by itself supply every cause or later interpretation of this part of Paul's story.
